conic_scaling: Actual weighted full59column norms. Protected cones transformed to same variables. Residual cones divided by physical limits; bound rows by widths. Bootstrap recomputes sample scaling.
constraints: Original bounds and four limits simultaneously on protected22 and full26: E_RMSE<=.1,F_RMS<=.5,max|E|<=.3,max atom-vector norm<=2. Rho scales all limits only for feasibility, never acceptance.
failure_handling: Count startup/interrupted attempts; archive commands/codes/stdout/stderr/native before cleanup. At most one additive retry, never overwrite failed directories; resume exact hash-verified completed requests only. Stop if required stage incomplete.
geometry_scope: Exact center deformations; not independently sampled conformational basins.
hypotheses: Four selected observations may constrain recurring bound/weak directions.
Better nominal matrix conditioning need not improve omission robustness.
New local residuals may expose incompatibility of unchanged model/data/bounds.

inherited_fit.acceptance: Same frozen energy/force/max gates on untouched validation plus predictive uncertainty; method-specific research only, never automatic assignment.
inherited_fit.candidate_activation: Full matching primary+joints, numerical gates, rank59/condition<=10000, solver success, no active bound, training thresholds and uncertainty all pass before untouched validation QM. A failed historical complete-basis gate alone never blocks this method-specific trial.
inherited_fit.condition_scope: Actual weighted59column matrix including offset; 10000 is an experiment identifiability screen, not prior987 geometry-only result or a physical certificate.
inherited_fit.curvature_constraints: Diagnostics only; selected-protocol baseline estimates not QZVP. No duplicate gradient-derived observations in objective.
inherited_fit.objective: mean((E_QM-E_fixed-Ap-offset)^2)/0.1^2 + mean(Cartesian_force_residual^2)/0.5^2; all81 components, one offset on training only
inherited_fit.offset: one unbounded additive training intercept in energy only; frozen unchanged on validation; subtract center electronic energy before kcal conversion for precision
inherited_fit.optimizer: scipy.optimize.lsq_linear TRF bounded linear least squares, column-scaled including intercept, tolerance1e-12,maxiter1000; no regularization

uncertainty.interval: 2.5/97.5percentiles only on explicitly eligible bootstrap replicates; retain every rank/conditioning/bound failure, no replacement resampling; failed fraction blocks eligibility. Absolute intervals for all coefficients incl near zero, covariance/correlations and prediction spread; limited small-block/model-discrepancy uncertainty, no physical confidence claim.
uncertainty.unit: whole training configuration/path blocks; all signs/steps of each primary path travel together; each joint and center separate blocks

intake: Exact request/protocol/geometry/hash; native convergence,399 orbital functions, all27 gradients; independent decimal energy and ASCII force conversion within1e-8 energy/1e-9 force. Existing J65 protocol precision remains mandatory, unchanged.
objective: Full26 mean(rE^2)/.1^2 + mean(rF^2)/.5^2; one unbounded energy-only intercept; no regularization/duplicate curvature.

resource_justification: Retained dense-TZVP training470-568s;1800s timeout,4GiB configured,6GiB RSS envelope+2GiB headroom; one native worker,4threads. File cache separately reported. No QZVP.

selection.rule: Raw solution; if LS physically violates, first strict-feasible convex blend toward verified rho witness in frozen sequence. Does not alter raw solver classification or erase original-bound activity.

solver.crosscheck: Independent SCS rho if nominal not physically feasible; checked dual support bound if rho>1; no solver failure is infeasibility.
solver.qualification: Inherited Solved required, additionally primal/dual residual<=1e-8 and absolute gap<=1e-7. AlmostSolved unqualified; report physical feasibility independently. No policy relaxation.

stopping: After four observations and numerical assessment stop this allocation; no automatic further QM or model expansion.

uncertainty.intervals: Absolute2.5/97.5percentiles, correlations and atom predictive effects; survivor-conditional/unqualified if overall failure.
uncertainty.rule: 14 blocks sampled with replacement14times. Optimize and constrain ONLY sampled observations with multiplicity; no protected/full post-fit constraints on omitted observations. Rho then conditional LS. Retain every failure; no replacement. Evaluate22/26 after fitting.

validation_activation: All nominal physical/numerical/original-bound/rank/condition and uncertainty gates pass; frozen vector/intercept hash, graph leakage rechecked, one-time activation and remaining budget>=3. No activation on any failure.
